The house rules

how every edition gets built

  1. 01

    Rising artists only

    Every slot goes to an artist on the come-up. No superstar backfill, no chart filler — if everybody already knows the name, it doesn't make the cut.

  2. 02

    Nothing from your library

    Artists already saved in the curator's library sit each week out, so every edition is genuinely new names and new records — discovery, not a replay.

  3. 03

    Fresh every Monday

    A brand-new ~28-track edition lands every Monday around 9 AM ET. Last week's drop stays in the archive below, so the run of finds never disappears.
